name: io.github.bulatko/vk
description: VK (VKontakte): read walls, users, communities and stats; publish, edit and comment on posts.

environmentVariables.description: VK API access token. Quickest route if you manage a community: Manage -> API usage -> Access tokens -> Create token, ticking wall and photos — no app needed, and it is tied to neither a browser nor an IP. To act as yourself, create your own Standalone app at https://vk.com/editapp?act=create and run `npx vk-mcp-server --login <APP_ID>`. Use your own app rather than a shared ID: a token dies with the app that issued it. Full guide: https://github.com/bulatko/vk-mcp-server/blob/master/docs/SETUP.md
environmentVariables.name: VK_ACCESS_TOKEN
